scope: Numeric extracts only. No generated outputs, salts, site values, process IDs or private paths. Diagnostic aggregates do not replace native performance metrics.

baseline.interval_definition: Median across requests of decode_seconds / (measured_sse_events - 1). These are per-request mean event intervals, not the median of individually timed event gaps.

replay.interval_definition: Median across requests of decode_seconds / (measured_sse_events - 1). These are per-request mean event intervals, not the median of individually timed event gaps.

budget.interval_definition: Median across requests of decode_seconds / (measured_sse_events - 1). These are per-request mean event intervals, not the median of individually timed event gaps.

budget_c1_only.interval_definition: Median across requests of decode_seconds / (measured_sse_events - 1). These are per-request mean event intervals, not the median of individually timed event gaps.

c1_window_limits: Full-suite bounds use the first C1 API response-header log through the first C2 header; not exact engine dispatch boundaries. C1-only uses native run bounds. Host counters are sampled and host-wide; log absence is not a full trace.

c1_only_actual_engine_counters.scope: Actual server counter deltas across each completed three-request native C1 run. No traffic beyond the expected three requests was counted.
c1_only_actual_engine_counters.limit: The equality between observed output events minus first events and draft rounds holds for these repeats. Historical client event counts remain transport observations, not independently verified engine counts.

local_cpu_sizing_test.scope: Local CPU sizing-only microbenchmark; no inference, no remote actions, no estimate of serving-rank cost or causal proof.

selector_parity.scope: Native frozen and selector bench.py: every common top-level function/class except CLI main is AST-identical; selector only adds skip-decode handling/settings in main.

limitations: The relationship between output-event counts and engine draft counts was checked only for the isolated repeats; historical event counts remain transport observations.
The local CPU test is not a production-host benchmark or causal proof.
Effectively zero host PSI does not exclude GPU stalls or all background work.
The snapshot without active thermal or power clock limits is not a continuous trace.
Non-benchmark traffic occurred between the original series and the follow-up.
